name: code-toolbar
description: One colored bar above the prompt: context, limits, tasks, and toggles you pick

ctxTarget.title: Context target (tokens)
ctxTarget.description: The context bar is full here; the % is measured against it

ctxBar.title: Context bar
ctxBar.description: Draw the context as a bar; off shows the compact 'ctx 62.7k' label

ctxCaution.title: Caution at (tokens)
ctxCaution.description: Orange at or above this many tokens

ctxWarn.title: Warn at (tokens)
ctxWarn.description: Red at or above this many tokens

taskBarCells.title: Task bar width (cells)
taskBarCells.description: Width of each blue task progress bar, 1 to 60

five.title: 5-hour limit
five.description: Show the 5-hour limit: time until reset and % used

week.title: 7-day limit
week.description: Show the weekly limit: time until reset and % used

alerts.title: Warning toasts
alerts.description: Pop up once when the context passes Warn, or the 5h limit passes 85%

ctxHandoff.title: Handoff on context click
ctxHandoff.description: Click the context bar to write a handoff note, /clear, and continue fresh (needs the mattpocock-skills handoff skill)
